QUOTE: A manual retry runs `retryFailedPost`, which re-sends the same post.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says there's no automatic retry, that a manual retry runs `retryFailedPost`, and that it is triggered from the failed-post UI's `Failed.onPress`. This covers the user-initiated-only retry and the function name, though it never uses the literal "Try Again" label.
